strongest_counterhypothesis: A conventional standards-based authorization stack (OAuth Token Exchange subject/actor + Rich Authorization Requests + sender-constrained tokens + resource indicators) combined with ordinary application provenance metadata can preserve exactly the same user/relay boundary more simply than a special ASVB mechanism.
evidence: In the synthetic benchmark an explicitly idealized RFC8693+RAR+DPoP baseline has the same 0 false-allow / 0 false-deny result as ASVB.
ASVB's measurable advantage appears only against bearer-only and scope-only baselines, not against the ideal standards baseline.
OAuth actor/subject, structured authorization, resource restriction and sender-constraining are established prior art.
